summary: Read two nonempty linked lists. Each list stores one nonnegative integer, with a single digit in every node and the highest place at the head of the list. Neither integer has a leading zero unless that integer is zero. Add the two integers and write the sum as a linked list that again keeps the highest place at the head. Leave the original node order unchanged while computing. Write the head of the list that stores the sum.
notes: Compare after trimming trailing newlines. The input is tokens in the same order as the method parameters.
